overview: 20 official Group 1 Prelims questions (2008–2024), 17 of them in 2023–24. Nuclear energy is the largest block (8 Qs: reactor stages, enrichment, dirty bomb, Kudankulam, PFBR); energy policy/programmes 6 (IREDA, SEEI, methanol, hydrogen); solar 3; resources 2; energy needs 1; wind none. Mostly 2–4-statement sets where one isotope, stage number, gas or developer is swapped.

possibility.what_they_ask: which bodies published an energy report (NITI Aayog + IEA), India's rank as energy consumer, share of thermal power

possibility.angle: Energy resources and import dependence (biogas, shale, coal, oil)
possibility.what_they_ask: chief constituent of a fuel (gobar gas = methane), basin with largest shale gas reserves (Cambay)

possibility.angle: Energy policy, PSUs and programmes (IREDA, BEE/SEEI, methanol, hydrogen)
possibility.what_they_ask: PSU status and parent ministry, state energy-efficiency index ranks/categories, objectives of a programme, who built the first hydrogen bus/ferry, how a fuel cell works
target capacity (100 GW solar by 2022), newest ISA member (119th = Malta), why India has high solar potential (~300 sunny days)
natural targets judged from the solar items: national target figure, leading states by installed capacity, NIWE Chennai, National Offshore Wind Policy 2015, wind-solar hybrid policy 2018

possibility.angle: Nuclear energy: three-stage programme, reactors, fuel, safety
possibility.what_they_ask: first plant (Tarapur), which stage an FBR belongs to, which isotope is enriched and to what %, what a dirty bomb is, why Kudankulam was delayed, PFBR developer, radioactive gas in cancer treatment (radon)

traps.spot: 'increasing the percentage of U-238 (the fissile isotope)'
traps.fix: U-235 is fissile; U-238 is fertile (breeds Pu-239)

traps.trap: Stage number of the three-stage programme shifted
traps.fix: Stage 1 PHWR (natural U); Stage 2 FBR (Pu-239); Stage 3 thorium/U-233

traps.trap: Radiological device described as a nuclear explosion; cost reversed
traps.spot: 'city-flattening', 'costlier than nuclear weapons' for a dirty bomb
traps.fix: Dirty bomb = conventional explosive spreading radioactive material; no fission yield; cheap
traps.pyq: dirty bomb II and III incorrect [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#75]

traps.trap: Reactant gas swapped in a fuel-cell statement
traps.fix: Fuel cell: H₂ + O₂ → electricity + water + heat
traps.pyq: hydrogen bus 'H₂ and CO₂' → H₂ and O₂; developer KPIT–CSIR not Veera Vahana [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#90]

traps.spot: multiple-correct list of reasons for a delay with one generic national event
traps.fix: Kudankulam: USSR break-up (1991) stalled the 1988 deal; 2011–12 protests delayed commissioning – the 1991 BoP crisis is not the keyed cause
traps.pyq: Kudankulam delay → I and III only [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#82]

traps.trap: Basin with famous gas swapped for the shale leader
traps.spot: options list KG, Cambay, Cauvery basins
traps.fix: KG is famous for conventional gas; largest shale estimate is Cambay
traps.pyq: largest shale gas reserves → Cambay Basin [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#137]

techniques.name: [E21/6] Three-stage map
techniques.how: Write PHWR → FBR → Thorium with fuel of each; place any reactor/fuel statement on the map.
techniques.example: FBR: Pu-239 fissions, U-238 breeds (I, II true); 'stage 1' false → I and II only [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#64]

techniques.name: Number ladder for uranium
techniques.how: Keep the ladder 0.7 → 3–5 → 20 → 90 (%); any % statement is placed on it.
techniques.example: 'weapons grade max 20%' sits at the LEU rung → false; 'U-238 fissile' false → Neither I nor II [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#69]

techniques.name: Chemistry sanity check
techniques.how: Write the reaction behind the device; a reactant or product that cannot appear makes the statement false.
techniques.example: Fuel cell 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O; CO₂ cannot be a reactant → II false; water-and-heat effluent true → I and II incorrect [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#90]

techniques.name: Negative-stem flip
techniques.how: Mark each statement T/F, then select the F ones when the stem says 'incorrect'.
techniques.example: Dirty bomb: I true, II false, III false; stem asks incorrect → II and III only [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#75]

techniques.name: Objective-bundle test
techniques.how: For programme-objective lists, ask if each item follows from the programme's name and purpose; all-true sets are common here.
techniques.example: Methanol Economy: import cut, GHG cut, coal/MSW-to-methanol all fit → I, II and III [group1-prelims-2024-paper2#83]

techniques.name: Cause-of-condition reasoning (A-R)
techniques.how: Check that Statement II is the physical reason for Statement I, not just a parallel fact.
techniques.example: High solar potential because of many clear sunny days → both true, II explains I [group1-prelims-2024-paper2#90]

confusions.remember: Thorium-232 is fertile; neutron capture gives fissile U-233 (Stage 3)
PHWR burns natural U with heavy water; FBR burns Pu and breeds more
RDD = conventional blast + radioactive dust; nuclear = fission/fusion yield
Reactors and Hiroshima = fission; Sun and ITER = fusion
Moderator slows neutrons; control rods absorb them
Tarapur = first nuclear power plant (US BWRs); Kudankulam = 1988 Indo-Soviet deal
PFBR keyed to BHAVINI (builds/operates); IGCAR Kalpakkam designs fast reactors; BARC Mumbai is the main research centre
IREDA = RE finance PSU under MNRE; BEE = energy-efficiency body under Ministry of Power (runs SEEI)
Bus = KPIT with CSIR-NCL (Pune, 2022); ferry = Cochin Shipyard (2024)

anchors: Tarapur – India's first nuclear power plant
Uranium: natural 0.7% U-235; power 3–5%; LEU < 20%; weapons ~90%
Radon – radioactive noble gas used in cancer therapy
JNNSM – 100 GW solar target by 2022 (raised from 20 GW)
SEEI 2023 – Karnataka top (86.5/100); AP a Front Runner
Renewables Integration in India 2021 – NITI Aayog + IEA
checklist: Is an isotope named? Check fissile (235, 233, Pu-239) vs fertile (238, Th-232).
Is a % or stage number given? Place it on the ladder/stage map.
Write the reaction for any fuel/device statement.
Developer or builder named? Confirm the company/lab.
Time-sensitive PSU status or index rank: judge as of the exam year.
Flip for 'incorrect' stems before choosing a code.
